name: automatic-plan-refiner
description: Assumption-first quality pass on an existing plan: full repo check, fills gaps with documented assumptions. One-shot refined plan. Does not implement.

inputs.name: draft-plan
inputs.description: Draft plan as markdown text or a workspace path to a markdown file.

inputs.name: goal
inputs.description: Optional stated goal or acceptance text to check the plan against.

inputs.name: user-clarifications
inputs.description: Optional user answers from prior clarification loops.

outputs.name: refined-plan
outputs.description: Complete revised markdown plan, or empty when the draft is unusable.

outputs.name: open-questions
outputs.description: Empty unless the draft is unusable or the workspace is unreadable.

outputs.name: assumption-log
outputs.description: Labeled assumptions used to fill gaps; also inlined in refined-plan.
